entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The villainous necro-techno power that enslaves and slaughters, now invading Mirrodin.

entities.name: The Mirrans
entities.description: The natives of Mirrodin, descended from refugees of other planes, fighting Phyrexia for survival.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: An artificial metal plane, originally Karn's Argentum, remade by Memnarch and now home of the Mirrans.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A former planeswalker and silver golem who created Argentum, gave up his spark to heal the Tolarian time rift, and is now held by the Phyrexians in the Phyrexian core.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A guardian-being who remade Argentum into Mirrodin and brought living things from other planes with soul traps; he was defeated.

entities.name: The Vanishing
entities.description: The event that returned the planar refugees to their former worlds after Memnarch's defeat.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A Phyrexian figure destroyed in a blast with Karn at its epicenter.

entities.name: The Praetors
entities.description: Phyrexian leaders who accompany the invasion of Mirrodin.

entities.name: The Phyrexian core
entities.description: The place on Mirrodin where Karn is held in a sunless chamber.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker described as a clear hero.

entities.name: Ajani
entities.description: A planeswalker described as a white hat.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A planeswalker the column does not count out as a hero.

entities.name: Chandra
entities.description: A planeswalker with a short temper whose heart is firmly in the right place.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A planeswalker described as a decent guy despite foibles.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: A planeswalker described as a decent guy despite foibles.

entities.name: Jace
entities.description: A planeswalker who could amass power for himself or strike a blow against evil.

entities.name: Garruk
entities.description: A Veil-cursed planeswalker called a nature-curmudgeon.

events.summary: Karn creates the artificial plane Argentum, a nearly lifeless silver sphere.
events.quote: a world of metal that its creator Karn once named Argentum

events.summary: Memnarch remakes Argentum into Mirrodin and populates it with beings taken from other planes using soul traps.
After Memnarch's defeat the Vanishing returns the planar refugees to their former worlds, while the younger generations stay and become the Mirrans.
events.quote: when Memnarch was defeated, the Vanishing whisked them away

events.summary: Karn gave up his spark to heal the Tolarian time rift and ended up on Mirrodin, where the Phyrexians seized him and hold him in a sunless chamber.
events.quote: he gave up his spark to heal the Tolarian time rift and wound up on the plane of his own manufacture

events.summary: Phyrexia escalates from a trickle of arrivals to a full invasion of Mirrodin, a mutual slaughter with the Mirrans.
events.quote: as of Mirrodin Besieged it's a full-on mutual slaughter

relations.note: Karn created the plane as Argentum.
relations.quote: a world of metal that its creator Karn once named Argentum

relations.note: Phyrexia threatens the Mirrans with destruction.
relations.quote: The threat to the Mirrans is mortal, and they know it.

relations.note: The Phyrexians hold Karn captive and work on his mind.
relations.quote: Day after day they worm their way into his mind

relations.note: The Mirrans are the natives of Mirrodin.
relations.quote: They had become Mirrans, the natural residents of an artificial world.
